unsupported: Fanslau, who grew up around woodworking through his father and an uncle who ran a circular sawmill, expanded the shop in 2019 to accommodate larger projects and added kiln capacity for year-round milling.

Services include on-site sawmilling up to 36 inches in diameter, drying in an indoor dehumidification kiln (nine-foot capacity) and a solar kiln (14-foot slabs), and planing up to 25 inches wide and 12 feet long.
